title: Syracuse schools may add more screen-time to kids’ days. Teachers aren’t sold.
summary: Syracuse City School District is planning to adopt i-Ready, an online educational platform, despite teacher concerns about increased student screen time. This procurement decision involves a significant digital-services initiative that will impact instructional practices and student technology exposure across the district.

political_signal.description: Teacher resistance to platform adoption signals implementation risk and potential workforce concerns about instructional methodology and student outcomes; suggests need for change management and stakeholder alignment before rollout.
